 WTVT Updated Tue, November 10, 2026 at 3:26 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The Tampa Bay area remains the epicenter of a nationwide Dengue Fever outbreak. Hundreds of cases have been reported in Hillsborough and Pinellas counties, but will an upcoming cold front help stop the spread? FOX 13's Blake DeVine reports.
